signature.name: Every Image Earns Its Place and Reads at Size
signature.description: Each image is a real capture, legible at ~880px, captioned, and shows a distinct part of the product.

group-a.signature_why: Two real, captioned, readable crops showing different parts of the report; first is mostly a large title block and both are light-only.
group-a.loved: Real report crops at full width with alt text and captions that say what you are looking at.
group-a.docked: Header crop spends a lot of space on a headline and empty stat tiles; no dark-theme handling and the first screen is text plus code before any image.

group-b.signature_why: Light/dark animated reel plus a full report card, all legible and alt-texted; the reel is a rebuilt diagram of real strings rather than a capture and repeats the quote.
group-b.loved: Input-check-output reel at the very top shows the product's one trick in five seconds, with dark/light variants and a static fallback.
group-b.docked: The reel is a constructed graphic, not a raw capture, and its quote is repeated in the report card; reel frames leave a lot of empty panel space while animating.

group-c.signature_why: One large, very legible, captioned real crop, but a single image and light-only with an honest caption; little variety to judge.
group-c.loved: The proof crop is big, sharp and captioned honestly (passing case only), paired with the exact transcript lines.
group-c.docked: Only one image for the whole page, the transcript code block clips at width, and there is no dark-theme handling or view of the rest of the report.
